intent: WP-0S (TIT-010): minimum fail-closed ingress floor for the dashboard API. Add an explicit production-shaped vs local-development mode to the canonical auth/config module (dharma_swarm/api_keys.py), refuse production-shaped startup when DASHBOARD_API_KEY is absent or blank, replace the /api path-prefix bearer scope in api/main.py with a default-deny transport classification covering HTTP and WebSocket ASGI scopes (closing the /holon and /graphql bearer bypass), bind the keyless local-development escape hatch to loopback clients only, fail the public webhook route closed in production-shaped mode when its verification material is absent, and pin the whole matrix in a new tests/test_api_auth.py. The A2A gateway keeps its own X-A2A-Key authority and is not touched.

commit.message: feat(api): WP-0S minimum fail-closed ingress floor (TIT-010)

interface_mismatches: INTERFACE_MISMATCH_MAP.md IMM-26 (dkeys/api_keys.py key-name contract) is RESOLVED and is the only entry touching this packet's surfaces; no open mismatch for the api/main.py and api_keys.py pair at base 1e806bd.
honest_blockers: The operator has not yet recorded the FastAPI deployment exposure status (CONTAINED / PRIVATE_ONLY / NOT_DEPLOYED / BLOCKED_OPERATOR) required by the spec before Phase 0 closure; this packet establishes the code floor and its closure state remains gated on that recording.

The webhook signature handler dharma_swarm/verify/github_app.py:117-122 returns True when DHARMA_VERIFY_WEBHOOK_SECRET is unset; that file is outside this packet's allowed files, so this packet fails the webhook route closed at the ingress layer in production-shaped mode only, and the handler-level keyless fail-open remains a recorded residual for a follow-up packet.

The spec's ambiguous-mode language is implemented as: explicit production mode refuses startup without a key and fail-closes all non-public ingress; ambiguous (unset) mode with a key enforces everywhere, and without a key binds the open lane to loopback clients only. Full startup refusal in ambiguous mode would break every keyless local/test startup path (23 test files use TestClient), which is outside this packet's blast radius; recorded as an interpretation, not silently decided.

Packet pytest gates run under the runner-admitted system python3; repo dependencies were made importable to system python3 via a user-site editable install (python3 -m pip install --user -e .[dev]) because the runner's positive allowlist admits neither .venv/bin/python nor make bootstrap as a gate command.

make test-fast on this host fails only on tests/conformance/test_repo_ratchet_holds.py::test_repo_quality_ratchet_has_no_regressions via the 10s pytest-timeout under suite load; per-occurrence re-proof (isolation pass + identical failure on unmodified base) is recorded in the PR body.

tests/test_verify_api.py is excluded from the runner gates because running it writes repo-local runtime state (.dharma/**) through SwarmManager's relative state_dir default (dharma_swarm/swarm.py:118, a DharmaGraph-owned surface outside this packet), which the closeout scope walker rejects as untracked files; that suite runs in the manual .venv battery with its exit code recorded in the PR body.
